title: Find All Duplicates in an Array
statement: Find all values that appear twice in an array whose values are in [1,n], using constant extra space.
explanation: Use each value as an index and negate that slot on first occurrence; a negative slot on a later occurrence signals a duplicate.

title: String Compression
statement: Compress a character array in place by replacing runs with the character and run length when greater than one.
explanation: Scan each run, write its character, and write decimal digits of the count when needed.

title: Add Two Numbers II
statement: Add two nonempty linked lists whose digits are stored in forward order, returning the sum as a linked list.
explanation: Push digits onto stacks, add from least significant to most significant, and prepend each result digit.

title: Arithmetic Slices II - Subsequence
statement: Count arithmetic subsequences of length at least three in an integer array.
explanation: For each ending index, track how many arithmetic subsequences of each difference end there and extend them with the current value.

title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
statement: Find all values in [1,n] missing from an array of length n whose values lie in [1,n].
explanation: Negate the slot indexed by each value; indices still positive correspond to missing values.

title: Delete Node in a BST
statement: Delete a node with a given key from a binary search tree and return the updated root.
explanation: Find the key; replace a node with zero or one child directly, or use the inorder successor for two children.

title: Sort Characters By Frequency
statement: Reorder the characters of a string in decreasing order of frequency.
explanation: Count characters and emit each character repeated by its count in descending frequency order.

title: Minimum Number of Arrows to Burst Balloons
statement: Find the minimum number of vertical arrows needed to burst all balloons represented by horizontal intervals.
explanation: Sort by right endpoint and shoot an arrow at the earliest possible end; reuse it for every interval containing that point.

title: Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements
statement: Find the minimum moves to make all array elements equal when each move increments n-1 elements by one.
explanation: Incrementing n-1 elements is equivalent to decrementing the remaining element, so the minimum is the sum of differences from the minimum.

title: 4Sum II
explanation: Count all sums from A and B, then pair each C+D sum with its negation.
